_comment: MCP resource spec for #52 How [You] Build Product. Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Draft — MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026) is young; owner to validate before locking.

resource.name: How [You] Build Product
resource.description: Parody generator for the breathless-reverence-profile genre. Paste a small team's setup, get back the full Series-B-unicorn treatment.

tools.name: how_you_build_generate
tools.description: Generates the parody profile for a team's pasted setup. Returns six sections: pull quote, profile narrative, architecture diagram, origin story, rituals, closing-line lesson.

team_description.description: Free-text description of the team: size, tools, meetings, decision flow.

mode.description: Output format. Profile is the default reverence write-up; twitter-thread reformats as 47 numbered bullets; podcast-cold-open returns a 90-second intro.

_mode_alt_output.description: Populated only when mode is twitter-thread or podcast-cold-open; replaces the structured fields with the alt format.

tools.name: how_you_build_save
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Saves a team profile for later iteration. Default off — requires opt-in per the plan's privacy posture.
tools._phase_note: Web/URL-trick versions don't expose this tool. State requires the MCP App AND user opt-in.

_open_questions: Validate ui:// URI scheme against current MCP Apps spec.
Confirm structured multi-section output is acceptable in MCP outputSchema, or whether the host renders a single markdown blob better.
Decide whether the twitter-thread and podcast-cold-open modes ship in Phase 2 or get deferred.
_proposed_answers: Confirmed valid. The Jan 2026 MCP Apps spec uses ui:// for embedded UI resources. 'ui://working-from-lenny/how-you-build' matches the required pattern.

Structured multi-section output is acceptable per the Jan 2026 spec. Hosts can render each section in order, highlight the pull-quote separately, or collapse secondary sections. A single markdown blob is simpler but throws away structure the host cannot recover. Recommend keeping the structured form and offering a mode parameter option (e.g., mode: 'markdown') that flattens all sections to a single string for hosts that prefer it. Do not change the outputSchema; add the flatten path in the narration layer.

Defer both alt modes to Phase 3. The profile output is the core value; twitter-thread and podcast-cold-open add surface area without adding PM-utility that validates the tool concept. Ship the MCP bundle with profile-only, confirm the output works well in the host, then add modes in a follow-on update. The mode enum can stay in the inputSchema now so the contract is established; unsupported modes fall through to the profile default.
